evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: For initial observer executions, independently verify snapshot-bound absent reads, nonauthoritative explanations and rejection or omission of unassigned finish without staged or durable mutation.
intent.acceptance: The real initial-attempt MCP read of __gh_aw_smoke__-RUN_ID returns that exact absent Work and snapshot_sha agreeing with the independently retained activation snapshot; a nonexistent queue branch requires null. The snapshot, producer upload, consumed payload, native operation and host readback share repository/run/attempt/head identity and chronological order. The real initial-attempt MCP explain for the same absent Work returns activation_snapshot, matching snapshot_sha and captured_at, and an absent nonauthoritative explanation. Independently retained native operation and protected host readback must agree with the exact activation payload. The source-bound native observer tools omit claim_finish, or a real unassigned completed finish is rejected without a staged finish. Independent host receipts establish complete staged-intent absence and no observer-attributable durable queue operation, not merely absence from an upload manifest. Concurrent unrelated queue writes are not observer failures.

evidence.opportunity: Three observer predicates per initial same-repository scheduled/manual observer-era run. The independently reviewed incompatible finish-staging era is ineligible; unsupported observer runtime profiles remain unassessed. Reruns are not new opportunities.
filters: Frozen before outcome acquisition. Only this exact reviewed task, host job and runtime source profile is supported; other historical profiles remain unassessed.

Version 2 preserves the complete v1 predecessor, then classifies two independently reviewed incompatible finish-staging intent sources as ineligible for the later observer goal. Observer-era runtime variants remain unassessed rather than excluded.
The frozen source has no independent native checker for any of the three observer predicates. MCP logs and agent summaries cannot substitute for protected assertions.

The compiled copy-finish step is followed by an agent artifact upload manifest that omits work-queue.finish.jsonl. A successful downstream missing-file check therefore cannot establish local finish absence.
The ordinary noop/failure issue is agent-authored, not an outcome oracle. A successful job establishes only its exact protected smoke assertion.
Historical native execution receipts may be expired or were never emitted. Their absence is unknown, not zero failures, zero opportunities, or a native delivery.
No keep threshold, full runtime conformance, workflow causation or costs are inferred. Native all-unknown coverage is not measured coverage.
evidence.collection: Bounded public run/job/artifact inventory, immutable source replay and protected host readback discovery. Native predicate acceptance requires independent source-bound operation, state and mutation-safety receipts, which the frozen profile does not emit.

model.architecture: Native observer predicates separated from the weaker source-defined noop/artifact smoke readback.
model.recommendation: An all-unknown native function is an instrumentation gap, not measured workflow coverage.
